# AquaTrace

AquaTrace is a web application for analyzing GPX routes and finding nearby drinking water points from OpenStreetMap data.

## Links

- [Website](https://aquatrace.uggla.fr/)
- [Sitemap](https://aquatrace.uggla.fr/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://aquatrace.uggla.fr/robots.txt)

## Features

- Upload a GPX route.
- View route distance, elevation gain, elevation loss, and elevation range.
- Find drinking water points near the route.
- Inspect water points on the map, elevation profile, and results table.
- Switch between OpenTopoMap and standard OpenStreetMap backgrounds.
